transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. [Name]. I'm here because I've been having this issue with eating. It's like... once I start, I completely lose control. It feels like I just disappear and something else takes over. I can be sitting there, telling myself to stop, but I just keep eating anyway until I'm so full I can't even stand it.
After one of these eating episodes, do you ever try to get rid of the food or 'make up for it'—like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot?

Yeah, I do. After I eat like that, I usually end up going to a bathroom... like in my dorm, or sometimes I'll find an empty one on a quiet floor of the library. And I make myself throw up. I just get so terrified that all that food is just sitting in my stomach, turning into weight. So I feel like I have to get rid of it.
Over the past few months, about how many times per week have these binge-and-purge episodes been happening?

For most of this semester, it's been happening several times a week. It's definitely not just a once-in-a-while thing. Um... if I look back over at least the last few months, there really hasn't been a single week where the cycle stopped.
Would you say that how you feel about yourself as a person is heavily tied to your body weight or shape?

Yeah, definitely. It pretty much dictates how I see myself. I mean, I can have a totally decent day in my classes, but... if I catch my reflection in a dorm window or something, and I think my stomach or my face looks bigger than the other guys around me, it just ruins it. It feels like I failed at everything, honestly. When I get like that, I just don't want anyone to even see me.
Can you tell me your current height and weight, and whether your weight has been in a normal range for your body, or notably underweight?

Um, I'm about 5'10", and I weigh around 155 pounds right now. As far as I know, that's considered a normal weight for my height. I'm definitely not underweight or anything. My weight has stayed pretty much around this range, maybe fluctuating a few pounds here and there, but it hasn't dropped super low.
